title: Val library configuration (val/config.json)
description: Everything that differs between Valiify component libraries. val-init substitutes these values into the shared agent templates. Anything NOT in here is shared methodology and belongs in the templates or the core skills.

name.description: Machine name — used in run ids and generated headers.

displayName.description: Human name used in agent prose ('the Short App type system…').

figmaFileKey.description: The 22-char key from the Figma file URL.

figmaFileName.description: Optional — the Figma file's title, for prose only.

paths.description: All repo-relative. Defaults match the Valiify library layout; override only where a repo differs.

designSystemSkill.description: The library-specific design-language skill (components, tokens, casing rules). Stays in the library repo — never in val-core.

tokenSource.description: Generated theme CSS the build agent reads token names from.

componentCss.description: The built library the val page consumes.

storiesDir.description: Storybook stories the registry generator scans; also the staleness reference for the registry.

toolsDir.description: Where val-init symlinks the core tools.

figmaTokensJson.description: Extract pipeline: the token source-of-truth new variables are added to.

claudeMdSections.description: Which CLAUDE.md sections the build agent must read fresh.

typography.description: The one area where the libraries' design systems genuinely diverge in agent behaviour.

fonts.description: Font packages the built page imports.

systemNote.description: One sentence appended after the font list in the build agent — the type-system constraint it must respect.
examples: the Short App type system is INTER-ONLY (all 24 text styles; there is no mono register in this design system)
Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono strictly for verifiable data

dataRule.description: How verifiable data (IDs, amounts, percentages) is set. Substituted verbatim into val-build rule 4 and val-context §4.
examples: tabular-nums (the system is Inter-only; no mono register exists)

audience.description: Sentence for val-context §1 describing which audiences/registers this library serves and how that selects component families.
examples: applicant-facing (the Short App application flow — fields, cards, actions) or portal/reviewer-facing (the Portal Specific set: StatusTracker, Action, UtilityButton). This selects which component families apply.
reviewer-facing or applicant-facing (this selects the design language register).

pipelines.description: Which pipelines to generate. Both default to true.
